name: push-up inside leg kick
description: A push-up where you kick one leg inward at the top. Adds core and hip work to the chest effort.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder width and your body in a straight line.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest, then push back up.
At the top, lift one leg and kick it inward beneath your torso toward the opposite side, keeping your hips as steady as you can.
Return the foot, perform the next push-up, and alternate legs.
